pSeek Harness alerts: taskbar badge, in-app badge, Windows notification and chime per session state.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that tells you when a session needs attention:

- **numeric taskbar badge** for finished, unread sessions;
- **red `!` badge** when a session fails;

- **amber `?` badge** when the agent is waiting for your answer;
- a short chime per state, and a W

The in-app badges pop in the bottom-right corner and open the session when
clicked.

The bundle is a client-side row: it registers no tools and runs no host code.

appear in-app and in notifications rather than on the
taskbar icon.

uested once, on your first click in the app.
